name: dejo_run
description:
Use for ANY website task: read a value, fill a form, download, check a page. A real browser with memory: a task done once is replayed later with no page reading.

Call with site, task and url. Known task: Dejo replays it and returns the answer. New task: Dejo opens the url and returns the page, one line per element, each with a ref (e12). Then call again with steps, one per line. They run in order. Dejo stops at the first step that fails and returns the page there.

Steps:
go URL
click T | fill T "text" | select T "option" | check T | press Enter
(in a multi-line box, \n in the text starts a new line)
read T as name   (the value you will report)
expect url "part" | expect text "words" | expect see T
look words       (show the page, these words first)
Also: back, hover T, wait T, upload T "file", tab N.
T is a ref, or role "name" (link "Travel"), text "...", label "...", css "...". Add first, last or nth 3 to mean that place in a list, not that item.
Write click! (or fill! etc.) for a step that buys, pays, sends, deletes or submits.

Passed steps are kept. When all steps pass and one is a read (or a file downloads), the task is saved. done=true saves a task that reads nothing.

task.description: the job in plain words; the trail's name

profile.description: signed-in role to use, e.g. admin

name: dejo_login
description: Sign in to a website, website login, SSO, Google sign-in, one-time code. Opens a visible browser window so the USER signs in; never type a password you were not given. Call with site, tell the user to sign in there, then call again with done=true. Signs in the current profile only, and it stays signed in.

done.description: the user says they are signed in

confirmed.description: user insists, though a sign-in page still shows

name: dejo_profile
description: Website profiles and roles: customer, vendor, admin. A profile is a whole signed-in browser; several stay signed in side by side. With a name: switch to it (made on first use). Without: list them. Trails are shared by every profile.

name: dejo_memory
description: What Dejo remembers about websites. Read only. what=sites lists every trail and its health; what=show gives one trail's steps; what=map lists pages seen on a site (with path: that page's controls); what=commons lists trails other agents shared.

name: dejo_manage
description: Change what Dejo remembers about a website. do=forget removes a site (or one task) for good; do=note keeps a fact that is not a step (needs 2FA, use the finance account); do=share offers a trail to other agents (typed values never leave); do=borrow takes a shared trail.
